caption: The video captures a demolition site where the skeletal frame of a multi-story concrete building stands with graffiti-covered columns, dangling rebar, and rubble strewn across the floor slabs. A yellow CAT excavator occupies the lower-left foreground, its boom largely stationary. On the right, an orange long-reach excavator holds a hydraulic shear near the top edge of the structure. The arm makes small positional adjustments as it works the upper floor. A plume of dust and fine debris drifts downward through the open interior. A discrete chunk of concrete in the upper interior descends vertically past the columns toward the lower part of the scene. A separate fragment stays fixed near a mid-left column. The background slabs remain in place, while much of the visible motion comes from the machines and debris.
